owaspFindingsResolved.title: Broken Access Control
owaspFindingsResolved.finding: IsStaffOrClientOfOrganization applied to all viewsets; each get_queryset scopes to user org; has_object_permission enforces org isolation at object level. IsApprover restricts approval actions to assigned reviewer.

owaspFindingsResolved.title: Cryptographic Failures
owaspFindingsResolved.finding: DRF TokenAuthentication used; no tokens logged or printed in any server-side code. HTTPS enforced in production by Google App Engine. Client stores token in localStorage (XSS risk accepted as known limitation for this architecture phase).

owaspFindingsResolved.title: Injection
owaspFindingsResolved.finding: All database access is via Django ORM queryset API. No raw SQL, cursor.execute(), or string-interpolated queries found in client_portal. GCS path construction uses UUID-prefixed keys via uuid.uuid4().hex - no user-controlled path segments.

owaspFindingsResolved.title: Security Misconfiguration
owaspFindingsResolved.finding: SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, and ALLOWED_HOSTS are all read from environment variables via django-environ. DEBUG defaults to False. AllowedHostsOriginValidator wraps WebSocket URLRouter in asgi.py, preventing cross-origin WebSocket abuse.

owaspFindingsResolved.title: Authentication Failures
owaspFindingsResolved.finding: Server-side: IsStaffOrClientOfOrganization.has_permission() returns False for unauthenticated users on all viewsets. Client-side: ProtectedRoute redirects to /portal/login when auth_token absent in localStorage.

performanceSummary.notes: No N+1 queries observed in viewset queryset implementations - all use select_related or filter-by-FK patterns. GCSFileStorageAdapter uploads are async-safe via Django default_storage. No synchronous blocking calls on critical paths. WebSocket channel layer uses Redis (configured in settings). No performance regressions identified against baseline.

defectsLog.title: ActivityEvent.actor FK non-nullable causes IntegrityError on system-initiated events
defectsLog.description: ActivityEvent.actor was a non-nullable ForeignKey to UserProfile. The RegisterClientOrganization use case calls _record_activity with actor_id=None (system-initiated event with no human actor), which would raise a database IntegrityError on save.
defectsLog.resolution: Made ActivityEvent.actor nullable (null=True, blank=True, on_delete=SET_NULL) in apps/client_portal/models.py. Created and applied migration 0002_make_activityevent_actor_nullable.

knownLimitationsLog.title: MySQL W036 - allauth EmailAddress conditional unique constraint
knownLimitationsLog.description: MySQL does not support unique constraints with conditions. The allauth EmailAddress model defines such a constraint. Django emits W036 warnings during migration. This is benign in development (SQLite) and deferred to deployment where the GAE Cloud SQL (MySQL) configuration will be validated.

knownLimitationsLog.title: Token stored in localStorage (XSS surface)
knownLimitationsLog.description: The React portal stores the DRF auth token in localStorage, which is accessible to JavaScript and therefore exposed if an XSS vulnerability is introduced. Mitigation: CSP headers should be configured at the deployment/GAE level. HttpOnly cookie upgrade is a future security hardening task.
